en.headline: Yellow fire danger warning in force on hot Mid-Autumn day
en.dek: The Observatory issued the yellow fire danger warning at 6am and a hot-weather health advisory as the festival day turns fine, dry and warm, with a mainly cloudy night for moon-watching.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Friday, Mid-Autumn Festival, saying the fire risk is high. A separate special weather hint at 6.45am warned that hot weather might cause adverse health effects and advised the public to stay alert and drink more water.

The morning bulletin, issued at 7.02am, recorded 28 degrees Celsius and 76 per cent relative humidity at the Observatory. Friday’s forecast is mainly fine and dry during the day, with temperatures between 27 and 32 degrees and cloudy periods at night. Light to moderate easterly winds are expected.

The nine-day outlook, updated at 6.05am, points to a hotter stretch over the long Mid-Autumn weekend. Saturday, a general holiday as the day following the festival, is forecast at 28 to 33 degrees with sunny periods and very hot, dry conditions by day. Sunday is expected to be mainly fine, dry and very hot, reaching 28 to 34 degrees, with little chance of significant rain.

The Observatory said the public should take extra care with open flames and incense during outdoor festival gatherings while the yellow fire danger warning remains in force. No rainstorm, thunderstorm or tropical cyclone signal was in force for Hong Kong on Friday morning.

zh.headline: 中秋正日發出黃色火災危險警告 日間炎熱乾燥
zh.dek: 天文台今早6時發出黃色火災危險警告，並提醒天氣炎熱或影響健康。正日大致天晴乾燥，晚上部分時間多雲，方便賞月。
body: 香港天文台今日中秋節早上6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高。台方其後於6時45分發出特別天氣提示，指天氣炎熱可能影響健康，呼籲市民保持警悄並多補充水分。
天文台7時02分的天氣報告顯示，總部氣溫28度，相對濕度76%。今日預測大致天晴，日間乾燥及炎熱，氣溫介乎27至32度，今晚部分時間多雲，吹輕微至和緩偏東風。
上午6時05分更新的九天預報顯示，中秋連假其後兩日會更熱。周六為中秋節翌日公眾假期，氣溫28至33度，部分時間有陽光，日間酷熱及乾燥；周日大致天晴，日間酷熱乾燥，最高可達34度，顯著降雨機會偏低。
天文台提醒，黃色火災危險警告生效期間，市民在戶外拜祭或慶祝時須小心使用明火及線香。周五上午本港未有暴雨、雷暴或熱帶氣旋警告生效。
